concept.title: Foot care and personal grooming
concept.shortdesc: Receiving foot care such as chiropody, podiatry and nail cutting, along with related grooming services like hairdressing and wigs.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: help with washing and dressing: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (personal care support at home)
dental care: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (dental treatment, not foot or hair care)
going to hospital or medical appointments: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (general health appointments)

section.title: Evidence and status

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed. The group re-formed in most resamplings of the data (stability 0.78).
Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. It would split into foot care (chiropody, podiatry, toenail treatment) and hair services (hairdressing, wigs, hair donation).

section.p: Identifier in this run: svc-112. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
